description: This file is a source module for a PyTorch export utility, specifically for exporting models to TorchScript and other representations. It includes functions and classes for tracing, graph transformation, dynamic shape handling, and related utilities to facilitate model export workflows within the torch.export framework.

classes.name: ExportDynamoConfig
classes.description: Dataclass managing export-specific configurations for Dynamo.

classes.name: ATenExportArtifact
classes.description: Dataclass representing the artifact produced when exporting to ATen IR, including graph module, signature, constants, and output specifications.

classes.name: ExportArtifact
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating the exported artifacts, including ATen artifact, input and output specs, fake mode, and module call signatures.
